# Measures and Numbers

## Capactities

At Ebla, the weight system used a Western mina of 470 grams, with a corresponding shekel of 7.83 grams. However, scribes working at the archives also employed other systems, such as the Levantine mina (1 mina = 50 shekels of 9.4 grams) and the Anatolian mina (1 mina = 40 shekels of 11.7 grams) [@Peyronel2006, 267; @Peyronel2016, 58].

```{r mina-prices, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
cat('

|----|-----|------|-------|

Note that Ru\'a-damu, the man entrusted with the silver, goes from Ebla to Nagar with a travel provision of 5 shekels of silver (39,15 gr, the equivalent in weight of two AA batteries). |
